verdict.rationale: AngelList documents generating board consents from templates and collecting signatures on-platform, plus uploading off-platform consents for record-keeping, so the board-consent drafting, e-signature and archive part is covered. Stockholder approvals and linking consents to the specific transactions they authorize are not evidenced. Missing for 10: stockholder approval/consent workflows, explicit linkage of consents to the transactions they authorize, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, board consents and stockholder approvals are drafted, routed for e-signature, and archived against the transactions they authorize

citations.quote: Generate & Execute: Create and use board consent templates to generate individual board consents and use the platform to complete signatures.
Record Only: Upload board consents that were drafted and signed off-platform for record-keeping purposes.
AngelList solves this problem with bulk e-sign, which enables administrators to sign an unlimited number of documents at once.
Now, Boards approve AngelList Equity Blocks in advance so standard grants no longer require individual board approvals.
